description: Document writer inventory (docs/rust-engine.md section 6). Generated by scripts/engine-writers.mjs; regenerate with --write and review every new entry.

classes.hist.do: PM.hist.do: one undoable step around a mutation callback
classes.edit.mutate: Edit.mutate / api.edit.mutate: a validated structural mutation callback
classes.history.transaction: hist.begin / history.begin: a raw transaction; writes until commit or cancel
classes.history.external: hist.external / history.external: an external undo entry around host-applied changes
classes.project-replace: replaceProject: the whole-document restore path (undo, load, rollback, remote sync)
classes.touch: PM.touch: a write that only announces the document changed
classes.anim.touch: api.anim.touch: the kernel form of PM.touch
classes.shader-uniforms: shaderHooks.syncShaderUniforms: rewrites shader layer uniforms from source
classes.host.pm: api.host.pm: hands the raw PM registry (and PM.proj) to extensions
classes.project-swap: PM.proj = …: replaces the live document object outside history
classes.asset-metadata: a write into PM.proj.assets outside history
classes.project-write: a write into PM.proj or an alias of it outside history
classes.render-queue-swap: the render queue swapping the live project for a queued job
classes.home-composition-match: Home's Open matching the new composition to the first media source
classes.blender-source-asset: Blender source assets written into PM.proj.assets
classes.agent-media-folders: agent media import placing assets into folders
classes.extension-layer-refresh: extension layers refilled with parameters when a definition registers
classes.material-fanout: shared-material channels copied to every peer layer
classes.aim-preserving: aim-preserving rewrites of 3D camera and light channels after reparenting
